<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="image-inputs">
<h1>Image inputs</h1>
<section id="experimental-status">
<h2>Experimental status</h2>
<p>Image inputs are currently a dreamer-ready, experimental TypeSafe feature. They require explicit opt-in with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">images=True</span></code>; request, answer, and limit behavior may change upstream. Do not treat this feature as production-ready. pyjev re-exports the SDK’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Image</span></code> object and forwards image requests. The official <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">typesafe-sdk</span></code> owns asset references, serialization, uploads, and transport.</p>
<p>If <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">images=True</span></code> is omitted, an image-bearing request may be rejected by the API. pyjev does not automatically enable the feature when it encounters an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Image</span></code> object.</p>
</section>
<section id="installation-and-image-construction">
<h2>Installation and image construction</h2>
<p>Image support requires <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">typesafe-sdk&gt;=0.7.5</span></code>. Passing a path or bytes does not require an optional dependency:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Image</span>

<span class="n">photo</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;photo.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The SDK also provides <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Image.from_base64(...)</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Image.from_pil(...)</span></code> is available when Pillow is installed through the optional SDK extra:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">&#39;typesafe-sdk[pil]&gt;=0.7.5,&lt;1&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Pillow is not a pyjev or base SDK dependency.</p>
</section>
<section id="first-image-decision">
<h2>First image decision</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">images</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">noul</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;Is a person visible in `photo`?&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;photo&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;door-camera.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">))},</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>

<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;probability true:&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">NoulResult.value</span></code> is the model’s probability signal for true, not a correctness guarantee. Image requests send the explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images:</span> <span class="pre">true</span></code> opt-in header through the official SDK.</p>
</section>
<section id="where-images-can-go">
<h2>Where images can go</h2>
<p>Pass SDK <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Image</span></code> objects directly in SDK-valid structured content. pyjev preserves them; it does not recursively rewrite content or read image bytes itself. Images can be placed in state, direct primitive instructions, Noul criteria, Choice criteria, and Score levels. For example:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>

<span class="n">candidate</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;candidate.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">red_reference</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;red.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">blue_reference</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;blue.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">images</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">choice</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;Which reference example best matches `candidate`?&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;candidate&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">candidate</span><span class="p">},</span>
        <span class="n">choices</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="s2">&quot;red&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">red_reference</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s2">&quot;blue&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">blue_reference</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s2">&quot;other&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Neither reference&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Use structured content rather than concatenating image representations into strings. When the same image is useful to several questions, place it once in state and refer to that state path to avoid repeated image input.</p>
</section>
<section id="named-references-with-assets">
<h2>Named references with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">assets=</span></code></h2>
<p>Use named references when the question contains a stable textual placeholder, including for a named decision:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">images</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">decide</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;returned-product&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;returned&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;returned.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">))},</span>
        <span class="n">assets</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;&lt;catalog-photo&gt;&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;catalog.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">))},</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The decision can remain portable text in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.pyjev.toml</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">[decision.returned-product]</span>
<span class="n">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;noul&quot;</span>
<span class="n">question</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Does the product in `returned` match &lt;catalog-photo&gt;?&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Supply the actual SDK <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Image</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">assets=</span></code> at execution time. Do not place binary data or base64 image blobs in decision TOML. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">assets=</span></code> is available on the sync and native async decision methods; see <a class="reference internal" href="../python-api/"><span class="std std-doc">Python API</span></a>.</p>
</section>
<section id="text-interpolation-with-attach-assets">
<h2>Text interpolation with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">attach_assets</span></code></h2>
<p>For advanced string interpolation, use the SDK client’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">attach_assets</span></code> context manager. Direct structured placement is simpler and preferred:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Jev</span>

<span class="n">photo</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;photo.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Jev</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">images</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">client</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">attach_assets</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">photo</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">noul</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Is the product shown here damaged: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">photo</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">?&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;returned item&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The SDK’s async client provides the same context-manager interface:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyjev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">AsyncJev</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Image</span>

<span class="n">photo</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;photo.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">AsyncJev</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">images</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">client</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">attach_assets</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">photo</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="n">jev</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">noul</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Is the product shown here damaged: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">photo</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">?&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;returned item&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>This is a low-level SDK feature exposed through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Jev.client</span></code>, not a separate pyjev asset registry.</p>
</section>
<section id="image-preparation-and-limits">
<h2>Image preparation and limits</h2>
<p>The current TypeSafe image API accepts PNG and JPEG still images. Documented limits include:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>at most 16 MiB per image;</p></li>
<li><p>each side between 280 and 1568 pixels;</p></li>
<li><p>total image area between 78,400 and 2,458,624 pixels;</p></li>
<li><p>a 32 MiB request-body limit and 32 MiB aggregate/expanded image limits.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The API does not apply EXIF orientation. Prepare pixels upright before sending. These limits are upstream behavior and may change; pyjev does not duplicate them with its own validator. See the <a class="reference external" href="https://docs.typesafe.ai/images">TypeSafe image documentation</a> for current requirements and errors.</p>
</section>
<section id="cost-and-repeated-references">
<h2>Cost and repeated references</h2>
<p>Image input contributes to input tokens. Reusing a reference in several places can expand the model input each time. When multiple questions use the same image, place it once in state and refer to its state path where possible.</p>
</section>
<section id="named-decisions-and-offline-compilation">
<h2>Named decisions and offline compilation</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compile_decision(...)</span></code> remains an offline, JSON-like request preview. It does not read image files or preview multipart data. For image-backed named decisions, compile and inspect textual placeholders such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;catalog-photo&gt;</span></code>, then provide the actual <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Image</span></code> through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">assets=</span></code> only during execution. Runtime image objects are not part of the named-decision schema or its fingerprint.</p>
</section>
<section id="errors">
<h2>Errors</h2>
<p>The upstream API may reject requests when image support was not enabled, when an image format or dimensions are invalid, a named asset is not referenced, or a request exceeds size limits. Let official SDK errors retain their status, request ID, and validation details. See the <a class="reference external" href="https://docs.typesafe.ai/images">TypeSafe image documentation</a> for current error guidance.</p>
</section>
<section id="security-and-policy">
<h2>Security and policy</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Visual similarity is not authentication, identity proof, or authorization.</p></li>
<li><p>Confidence is a model signal, not the probability that an answer is correct.</p></li>
<li><p>Images may contain sensitive data and are sent to the configured TypeSafe-compatible API.</p></li>
<li><p>Apply the same data-handling and access policies used for other request content.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>This initial image integration is a Python API feature. pyjev’s CLI does not add image path flags or image transport.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
